capabilities: Insert numbered, named, and inline footnotes via hotkeys, including from selections and multiple cursors
Jump between footnote references and definitions and edit definitions in a popup editor
Rename or delete a footnote everywhere in the note in one step
Convert a whole note between normal and inline footnote styles
Lint footnote placement, duplicates, orphans, and numbering, with optional per-note prefixes for merged chapter notes
extras: No default hotkeys; the README says to assign them in Settings right after installing. Created by Alexis Rondeau and Micha Brugger, maintained and expanded by Jason Qin. Donations accepted via Ko-fi and GitHub Sponsors. A plugin wiki and debug guide are hosted outside the README. Works on Obsidian Mobile (iOS 16.4 or later). Copy-and-paste carrying footnote definitions is limited to a single Obsidian window.
motivation: Built from a forum post by jacob.4ristotle describing the manual work of scrolling to the bottom to count footnotes, typing [^n] twice, and moving back and forth to write citations.
problem: In Obsidian, adding a footnote means manually checking existing numbers at the bottom of the note, typing the reference, then moving to the end to type the definition by hand.

summary: Keyboard-driven footnote toolkit that inserts, navigates, renames, deletes, converts, and lints footnotes, with a popup editor at the cursor.
